title.zh: 将拉古纳省潘吉尔市镇巴利安村学校的名称变更为Victor Oteyza De Guia, Jr.纪念村学校的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of Balian Barrio School in the Municipality of Pangil, Province of Laguna, to Victor Oteyza De Guia, Jr. Memorial Barrio School
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of Balian Barrio School in the Municipality of Pangil, Province of Laguna, to Victor Oteyza De Guia, Jr. Memorial Barrio School

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1967/ra_5123_1967.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The name of Balian Barrio School in the Municipality of Pangil, Province of Laguna, is hereby changed to Victor Oteyza de Guia, Jr. Memorial Barrio School.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 17, 1967.
